# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_ebase.py - do not edit manually.
# Extraplanetary Base ground types (ground types design § 5, § 8), country scope.
# See scripts/generators/gen_ebase.py; sr_ebase_refresh (sr_colony_module_effects.txt)
# calls them.

# Our levels on each mining method, and on all of them (§ 8.3's f(m)), into
# var:sr_eb_lv_<pm> and var:sr_eb_lv_mining for sr_eb_share_<pm>: one walk of our
# Extraplanetary Bases. A method outside the seven goods is not counted.
sr_eb_count_methods = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_mine value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners value = 0 }
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_regolith_processing } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_space_mine } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_mine add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_space_colony_mining } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_self_replicating_miners } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners add = level } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_regolith_processing value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_space_mine value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_space_colony_mining value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_self_replicating_miners value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners }
	set_variable = {
		name = sr_eb_lv_mining
		value = {
			value = 0
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners
		}
	}
}

	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_proteus } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_proteus }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_pluto value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_pluto } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_pluto }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_eris value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_eris } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_eris }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_makemake value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_makemake } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_makemake }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_haumea value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_haumea } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_haumea }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_sedna value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_sedna } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_sedna }
	if = {

	}

	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_marius_hills } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_marius_hills }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_imbrium value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_imbrium } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_imbrium }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_over value = local_var:sr_ebm_over }
}

# The base's two layers (§ 5.2) from where its levels work: T, the average grade
# over the levels, past the room at -75%, into var:sr_ebase_grade (percent);
# and each good's D(g), the places' types' mixes weighted by levels x (1 + grade),
# past the room as Mixed, into var:sr_ebase_mix_<good> (signed, percent) and
# var:sr_ebase_mix_<good>_units (its size, the modifiers' multiplier). Multiplied
# first, divided last (fixed point).
sr_eb_compute_mix = {

# The base's mix on every Extraplanetary Base building we own (§ 5.3): buildings
# hold no variables, so the figures are the country's (root.var:). sr_eb_strip_mix
# removes all fourteen from every base, with or without In-Situ Resource
# Utilization, so a captured base sheds its old owner's mix; sr_eb_apply_mix then
# adds one a good, the bonus or the penalty by its sign, at its size. The refresh
# strips once and applies after (remove before add; a same-name add stacks).
sr_eb_strip_mix = {
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty }
		}
	}
}
sr_eb_apply_mix = {
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass_units }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The grade the next Extraplanetary Base level would work at (UI pass design § 8):
# built and queued levels fill the room best grade first, as sr_eb_fill_by_grade does;
# the first room left unfilled is where the next one goes, past all of it
# -75%. Into var:sr_ebase_next_grade, from sr_ebase_refresh.
sr_ebase_next_fill = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_next_left value = sr_ebase_queued_levels }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_next_found value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = -75 }
	# 16 Psyche at +30%
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_eb_next_found = 0 global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_psyche } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_psyche } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_eb_next_left >= sr_site_ebase_room_psyche }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_next_left subtract = sr_site_ebase_room_psyche }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 30 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eb_next_found value = 1 }
		}
	}
	# 4 Vesta at +20%
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_eb_next_found = 0 global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_vesta } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_vesta } }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_eb_next_left >= sr_site_ebase_room_vesta }
